Hi Mina / Acme team,

Thanks for the note. Short answer: we recommend the vendor portal as the primary path (better idempotency, PO matching, and faster AP processing). That said, we support an email fallback with strict conventions — reasonable for a gradual migration. Below is what we need to accept email reliably: 

- Subject token: "REDWOOD-INV: <vendor_name>" (e.g., REDWOOD-INV: Lumos) — required.
- Filename convention: "inv_<YYYYMMDD>_<PO#|POs>_<vendor>.pdf/csv" (POs can be comma-separated).
- PO handling: put all PO numbers on the invoice header line; if multiple POs map to different line items, include a separate line per line-item with the PO in the PO column. 
- Minimum fields (CSV): invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount, currency, po_number, line_description, line_amount. See attached minimal CSV sample.

I attached a small CSV example and a one-page PO-stamp guideline that AP prefers. If Acme can begin with email using the subject token above, we can route to a queue that applies automatic PO stamping and idempotency checks. Portal adoption remains recommended for high-volume flows.

Next steps
- Acme: confirm subject token and whether they need multiple POs per line.
- Lumos: confirm you'll include the sample CSV headers in your outbound email transformation.
- Internal: I'll loop in Kimberly and Marcus for a quick approval on the email fallback parameters.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Vendor Success Lead | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: sample-minimal-invoice.csv)

Hi Mina / Acme team — following up with the agreed path.

Summary of decision (approved by AP & Procurement):
- Primary: Vendor portal (recommended for ongoing volume).
- Fallback (accepted): Email to billing@redwood.ai with subject starting exactly: "REDWOOD-INV: <vendor_name>".
- Filename: inv_<YYYYMMDD>_<PO#|POs>_<vendor> (PDF/CSV).
- PO rule: AP requires a separate line item per PO for accurate ledger mapping; do not collapse multiple PO numbers into a single header field. If an invoice legitimately needs to cover multiple POs, include multiple line items with the corresponding po_number on each line.
- Idempotency: system will auto-deduplicate emails within a 7-day window; duplicate hits after that will trigger manual review.

Attached: sample-minimal-invoice.csv (header + two example rows) and a one-page PO stamping guide. Please test with one sample invoice via email (use subject token) so we can confirm automatic routing. Once validated, we'll provision the Acme vendor record in the portal and send onboarding details.

Questions? If you want, we can schedule a 20-minute call to walk the AP/Operations team through the filename rules.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Vendor Success Lead | Redwood Inference
